title: Question and answer
description: One question an agent asked before it started: every option it offered, the answer that won, and the reason underneath.

value.question: Where does the loading threshold live?
value.reason: One number a person can find and change. A threshold per widget is three settings nobody tunes, and a threshold per binding is a number nobody can explain a week later.
